item.tib: rtsa gsum bder gshegs 'dus pa'i las bzhi gnad kyi 'dzab them
item.coloph: ces rig 'dzin stong rgyung mthu chen gyi las bzhi gnad kyi 'dzab them 'di nyid snyigs dus kyi sngags 'chang bdud srin 'dul ba'i gnyen po gar dbang bdud 'dul rtsal dang / snying gi ze'u 'bru 'chang ba'i ldong btsun sa trig ming gis/ lha rdzas dri ma med pa'i mtshams sbyar te/ bskul ba brten nas/ snyigs dus kyi skabs su bab pa'i tshe dbang bde chen snying po'am/ gsang mtshan g.yung drung thog med rtsal du 'bod pa bdag gis dus dang skabs su babs pa dran nas rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro'i bka' yi zhal lung bzhin du smin gling nas dge bar spel/ dam med lag tu u ya tham//
